external.description: Random dribbles following the Cavaliers’ 124-112 road loss to the Charlotte Hornets on Monday. 1. Well, at least the Cavs are undefeated in the NBA Cup. 2. Other than that, this early season can best be described as a disappointment. Monday’s loss to an injury-riddled and struggling Hornets squad was the best example. 3. This was supposed to be an opportunity to get right. Instead, the Cavs gave Charlotte one. The Hornets arrived with the league’s worst offense and enough injuries to fill a starting lineup. They proceeded to lead by 33.
external.title: Dribbles: Same old issues cost Cavs mightily against shorthanded Hornets
